title: Automated AI Follow-Up Agent
short_description: A client came to Sitechs with a common challenge, missed follow-ups. They had a Google Sheet to track customers and an email inbox, but manually sending reminders was eating up valuable time.
our_solution:
We built an AI-powered Follow-Up Agent that:

- Automatically identifies missed follow-ups
- Sends timely reminders to customers
- Improves customer satisfaction
results: The result? A more efficient follow-up process that saved the client hours of manual work.

title: Hiller Media Group
short_description: Hiller Media Group approached Sitechs to revamp their outdated website and improve their digital presence. They needed a modern, fast, and easy-to-manage platform that aligned with their brand and showcased their services effectively.
our_solution: We designed and developed a sleek, user-friendly WordPress website tailored to HMG’s media-focused audience. The new site features an intuitive layout, optimized loading speed, and SEO-friendly structure — making it easier for visitors to explore their portfolio and connect with the brand.
results: A professional online presence that strengthened HMG’s credibility, improved user engagement, and simplified content management through WordPress’s easy backend system.

title: Smart Office Management System
short_description: Vezyon needed a centralized platform to manage employee attendance, shifts, and HR operations. Their existing manual process created inefficiencies in tracking biometric data, managing leaves, and maintaining employee records.
deliverables: Office Management Portal with Biometric Integration
our_solution: We developed a comprehensive Office Management Portal using PHP Laravel, seamlessly integrated with the client’s biometric attendance system. The platform enables real-time employee tracking, shift scheduling, and application management (leaves, late arrivals, and more). The admin dashboard provides instant visibility into workforce performance and attendance trends.
results: A fully automated office management system that reduced manual HR work, improved attendance accuracy, and enhanced operational transparency across departments.

title: Upfeeds
short_description: Creative Triplet approached Sitechs to develop a custom tool that could simplify Upwork job monitoring. They needed a system that delivers real-time, personalized job alerts directly to their desktop — helping them respond faster and never miss new opportunities.
deliverables: Upwork Alerts Portal with Desktop Notifications
our_solution: We built Upfeeds, a custom web portal designed to monitor Upwork job listings in real time. Using intelligent filters and user preferences, it automatically detects relevant job posts and sends instant desktop alerts. This allows freelancers and agencies to stay on top of new leads without manually refreshing Upwork all day.
results: A productivity-boosting platform that helped Creative Triplet save time, increase their Upwork response rate, and secure more projects through instant job alerts.

title: Zoop - WhatsApp AI Agent for CRM Automation
short_description: A client approached Sitechs with a unique idea “Can my CRM talk on WhatsApp?” They wanted their customers to perform tasks directly from WhatsApp instead of logging into the CRM every time.
our_solution:
We built Zoop, a WhatsApp-based AI Agent that connects directly with the client’s CRM. Customers can now interact naturally using simple messages like:

   Hey Zoop, create an invoice for order #1204 Hey Zoop, show my pending tickets

 Zoop understands each command, processes it in real time, and responds instantly all without requiring users to log in. From creating invoices to checking payments or adding notes, Zoop handles it all through a smooth conversational flow.
results:
- 70% faster response times 

- Improved customer satisfaction 

- Zero repetitive work for internal teams 

Zoop transformed the client’s CRM into a conversational platform, making automation feel as natural as chatting with a friend.
